summary: Complete walkthrough of the CRM Email Outreach deployment. Covers 3 completed tasks: (1) Import of 456 deduplicated leads from CSV into Supabase with tier breakdown, (2) New Send Email UI features in EmailOutreach.tsx including per-lead send buttons, bulk send with progress bar, and real-time quota display, (3) Automated follow-up cron job on VPS running daily at 10 AM ICT with 3-day and 7-day follow-up rules.
